instruction: A candid full-shot photograph captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt (R2) stands facing right, watching her partner. In the center-right, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands with his back to the camera, balancing on his left leg while kicking his right leg out horizontally toward her. Overhead studio lights cast soft shadows on the red carpet. The scene is captured from a wide angle, showing the spacious studio environment.
